text.es: Yo solo tengo un motivo para estar aquí, y eres tú. Tu eres el amor de mi vida. Y siento que el simple hecho de estar aquí a tu lado no haya sido suficiente para demostrártelo. Escúchame, si tú me pides más, yo te lo voy a dar. Y no porque me lo pidas, porque a mí me apetece hacerlo así.
text.en: I have only one reason to be here, and it's you. You are the love of my life. And I'm sorry that simply being here by your side hasn't been enough to prove it to you. Listen to me, if you ask me for more, I'll give it to you. And not because you ask me to, but because I want to do it this way.
